questions.explanation:
Problem Explanation: 
Find the spring balance reading when two equal 15 kg masses are hung over pulleys in equilibrium. 

Concept: 
The spring balance measures the tension in the string. In equilibrium, tension equals the weight of one mass. 

Formula:  T= m × g 

Calculation:  T = 15 × 9.8 = 147 N 
The spring balance reads the tension. Converting 147 N back to kg (dividing by 9.8) gives 15 kg. 

Final Answer: 15 kg

Let's break down why:
• Rh-negative mother, Rh-positive fetus:
• During pregnancy, some of the fetal blood can cross into the mother's bloodstream.
• If the mother is Rh-negative and the fetus is Rh-positive, her body can recognize the Rh-positive blood as foreign and start producing antibodies against it.
• These antibodies can then cross back into the fetus and attack its red blood cells, leading to complications like anemia and jaundice.
Why the other options are incorrect:
• Male is Rh- and female is Rh-: If both parents are Rh-negative, the fetus will also be Rh-negative and there is no risk of Rh incompatibility.
• Male is Rh+ and female is Rh+: If the mother is also Rh-positive, there is no risk of Rh incompatibility.
• Male is Rh- and female is Rh+: In this case, the mother is Rh-positive and the fetus can be either Rh-positive or Rh-negative. If the fetus is Rh-negative, there is no risk of Rh incompatibility
